in_marathi.name: Bharti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Giver of Joy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bharti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bharti is derived from the Sanskrit word Bhartu, meaning 'to bear'. The name Bharti refers to the one who brings happiness and joy to others. It is also associated with the Goddess Bharti, who is believed to protect and nurture her devotees.
